description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are not maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of hardware inventory systems, missing CMDB entries for physical devices, lack of asset tracking processes, or gaps in hardware asset documentation. Organizations should maintain comprehensive inventories that include physical devices, networking equipment, servers, workstations, mobile devices, and IoT devices.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
